title: "Software"

---

Open-source Python packages behind the methods, each with documentation and tutorials.

**[soumap](https://jjtphd.github.io/soumap/)** · [GitHub](https://github.com/jjtphd/soumap)\
Self-Organizing UMAP: a hybrid SOM/UMAP algorithm that jointly learns data prototypes and their low-dimensional embedding, with multiview clustering (MPEC).

**[vqlp](https://jjtphd.github.io/vqlp/)** · [GitHub](https://github.com/jjtphd/vqlp)\
Vector quantization under arbitrary L*p* metrics, with recall quantities: prototype assignments, quantization error, receptive fields, and the connectivity graph.

**[gtsom](https://jjtphd.github.io/gtsom/)** · [GitHub](https://github.com/jjtphd/gtsom)\
General-topology Self-Organizing Maps: SOM training on arbitrary output-space geometries.
